title: nabalus × mainensis
intro: Nabalus × mainensis, commonly known as Main's ragwort, is a hybrid plant species within the family Asteraceae. Main's ragwort is known to have several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic. Bioactive constituents of Main's ragwort include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
